answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an agent economy can bind identities to physical proof-of-presence beacons. Nodes must continually decode an optical signal emitted by an anchored verification lantern within dedicated facilities, such as saffron storage vaults. An adversary incurs the verifiable capital cost of deploying separate sensor hardware for every forged identity. However, this mechanism remains vulnerable to relay attacks that proxy authentic beacon telemetry to remote virtual agents.
